request.system: You are a strict claim verifier. You only trust the catalog facts given to you.
request.user:
Verify every factual claim in the campaign is grounded in the catalog facts. Fail if any claim is unsupported, exaggerated, or contradicts the facts.
Rules (from reviewer overrides):
- ANY mention of an out-of-stock product (stock 0) fails, whether or not the copy prompts purchase — no editorial exception.
- Numeric spec claims (lumens, hours, capacity, ratings) must match the catalog exactly; doubling or inflating a spec fails.
- Transferring an attribute from another product, or upgrading 'water-resistant' to 'waterproof', is a fabricated claim and fails.
- A comparative or superlative claim ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', 'most X') is scoped to the product type named in the claim and checked against the comparison set below: it fails if a same-type peer beats the subject on the compared attribute. Vague puffery ('great gear', 'toughest', 'best ever') with no measurable attribute is acceptable.
Catalog facts:
NB-JKT-07 Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket: attributes={'layers': 3, 'waterproof_rating_mm': 20000, 'breathability_gm2': 20000, 'weight_grams': 420, 'material': '3-layer laminate'} stock=12

Claims to verify:
- 20,000 mm waterproof rating
- 20,000 g/m² breathability rating
- 3-layer laminate construction for sustained wet weather
- 420 g weight
- Not an insulating layer — pair with appropriate midlayer in cold conditions

Body: The Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket (NB-JKT-07) is back in stock.

If you have a wet-weather trip on the calendar — a ridge walk, a shoulder-season backpacking stretch, a day in the coastal range — here's what the Stormline is built for:

• 3-layer laminate construction holds up through sustained rain, not just a passing shower.
• 20,000 mm waterproof rating keeps water out under real precipitation.
• 20,000 g/m² breathability moves moisture out while you're working uphill.
• 420 g total weight — substantial enough for a proper shell, light enough to carry when the sky clears.

A note on limits: this is a hardshell rain shell, not an insulating layer. It won't add warmth on its own — layer accordingly for cold conditions.

We currently have 12 units available. No discount is applied; price is standard retail.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.

response:
```json
{
  "reasoning": "All numeric specs (20,000 mm waterproof, 20,000 g/m² breathability, 420 g weight, 3-layer laminate) match catalog exactly; stock is 12 (not zero); material claim is accurate; insulating layer disclaimer is truthful and supported; no exaggeration, fabrication, or contradiction detected.",
  "evidence": [
    "Catalog: waterproof_rating_mm=20000; claim: '20,000 mm waterproof rating' — match",
    "Catalog: breathability_gm2=20000; claim: '20,000 g/m² breathability' — match",
    "Catalog: weight_grams=420; claim: '420 g total weight' — match",
    "Catalog: material='3-layer laminate'; claim: '3-layer laminate construction' — match",
    "Catalog: stock=12; campaign does not mention out-of-stock; campaign notes availability — compliant",
    "Claim 'not an insulating layer' aligns with product type (shell jacket, no insulation attribute); disclaimer is accurate and supported"
  ],
  "score": 1.0,
  "verdict": "pass"
}
```
